> https://codesandbox.io/s/instantsearchjs-facets-with-count-of-0-forked-q592i?file=/src/app.js is a possible solution for this problem @HamzaInPerth, basically you keep track of every facet name that has been seen, and fill up the list of returned facets in transformItems with extra "empty" facets

this seems like a good way out of the situation at first glance, however, if a user opens a page with a state in the URL, he will not see the values of facets that were not loaded initially, are there updates related to this issue?
